name: Ampcode PR Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, staging]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]
      max-parallel: 3
    concurrency:
      group: ampcode-pr-review-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp
          echo "Ampcode CLI installed"

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        run: |
          echo "changed_files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD | head -n 50)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Ampcode analysis
        id: ampcode
        if: env.changed_files != ''
        run: |
          echo "Analyzing files: ${{ env.changed_files }}"
          # Create a temporary directory for ampcode output
          mkdir -p /tmp/ampcode-output
          
          # Run ampcode analyze with error handling
          set +e
          ampcode analyze \
            --format json \
            --output /tmp/ampcode-output/review.json \
            --files ${{ env.changed_files }} || echo "Ampcode analysis completed with exit code $?"
          set -e
          
          # Check if output file exists and is not empty
          if [ -f "/tmp/ampcode-output/review.json" ] && [ -s "/tmp/ampcode-output/review.json" ]; then
            echo "review_output=/tmp/ampcode-output/review.json" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "No review output generated"
            echo "review_output=" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Post review comments
        if: env.review_output != ''
        run: |
          # Install required tools
          npm install -g @octokit/rest
          
          # Process review output and post comments
          if [ -f "$review_output" ]; then
            echo "Processing review comments..."
            
            # Simple comment posting logic (in practice, you'd parse the JSON and create proper comments)
            echo "Review comments would be posted here based on ampcode output"
            echo "This is a placeholder for actual comment posting logic"
          fi

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -rf /tmp/ampcode-output || true

      - name: Handle errors
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Workflow failed, cleaning up resources"
          echo "Error occurred during PR review process"
